propositions: Vendor-neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py hardcode Jira adapter lazy-load keys that execute vendor code for any backend, violating backend separation
Comment-body formatting and truncation on the outbound-diff path route through literal lazy-keys instead of the backend port's FieldSanitizer role
Inbound ADF normalization on the apply path uses a literal lazy-key to load Jira adf_to_text instead of the backend port's InboundMapper role
FieldSanitizer must gain a new fit_comment method and InboundMapper must gain normalize_rich_text to route both vendor concerns through the port
All occurrences of the literals _ADF_KEY, _COMMENT_LIMITS_KEY, and _ADF_KEY_APPLIER in neutral core paths must be deleted and replaced with port-based resolution
A sweep gate must verify no package-root core module contains the string rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira except for the recorded inbound_fields.py exemption
